DurationValidator: $t(property.{property})的时长应在[{constraints.0} 秒, {constraints.1} 秒]范围内
HeightValidator: $t(property.{property})的画面高度应在[{constraints.0} px, {constraints.1} px]范围内

MaxWidthValidator: $t(property.{property})的画面宽度应小于等于{constraints.0} px
